entries.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
entries.snippet: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

entries.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
entries.snippet: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is seeking to gain Israeli backing for the US-backed Gaza peace plan.

entries.title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
entries.snippet: A 14-year-old child was among four others injured, the acting governor of Russia's Belgorod region says.

entries.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
entries.snippet: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.

entries.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
entries.snippet: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.

entries.title: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
entries.snippet: The leading opposition candidate calls allegations of a planned insurrection as "total fabrications".

entries.title: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
entries.snippet: About 200 firefighters worked to keep the fires from converging on Salamina, with one now under control.

entries.title: Ferrari's first ever electric car sold for record $40m
entries.snippet: The Luce's launch drew backlash from some commentators who said it broke from the brand's signature dramatic styling.

entries.title: Record rains drench South Korean city as landslide kills one
entries.snippet: It comes as large swathes of East and South East Asia have been pummelled by dats of heavy rain.

entries.title: Movie that went viral for terrible animation becomes China box office hit
entries.snippet: Niu Lai's confusing plot and laughable animation quality has won ironic fans on the internet.

entries.title: Aussie rules footy players under investigation as police probe sexual assault claim
entries.snippet: The Sydney Swans confirmed an incident had occurred in the hours after the team's win on Sunday.

entries.title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
entries.snippet: The works were taken overnight without alarms being triggered, raising suspicion of a professional hit.

entries.title: Teen suspect in Virginia campus shooting found hiding in closet
entries.snippet: The attack left five injured outside a halls of residence, and the suspect was not a student there, say police.

entries.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
entries.snippet: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

entries.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
entries.snippet: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.

entries.title: About 100 homes swept away after Hurricane Lala lashes Hawaii
entries.snippet: The state's governor says there "amazingly" does not seem to have been any loss of life besides a car crash.

entries.title: 'Ghana was the crime scene': The country leading the demand for slavery reparations
entries.snippet: Ghana has become Africa's leading voice in telling the world that Western nations owe reparations

entries.title: Thailand has a gun problem - 10 million of them
entries.snippet: Recent shootings have highlighted the country's troubled relationship with guns, with laws doing little to curb the violence.

entries.title: Many Canadians are boycotting the US, so this is where they're travelling instead
entries.snippet: From exploring their own backyard to travelling abroad, many Canadians are spending their money elsewhere to send a message to the US president.

entries.title: Five years after the Taliban swept to power, does the West have any influence?
entries.snippet: Five years after the Taliban swept to power, many are asking whether the West has any bargaining chips left

entries.title: USS Washington to relieve USS Lincoln. And, Jared Kushner to meet with Netanyahu
entries.snippet: The USS Washington is on its way to the Middle East to relieve the USS Lincoln amid concerns about conditions aboard. And, Jared Kushner is expected to meet with Prime Minister Netanyahu to move Gaza talks forward.

entries.title: Hayden Panettiere, who starred in 'Heroes' and 'Nashville,' dies at 36
entries.snippet: A child actor since she was cast in various commercials as an 11-month-old, Panettiere was best known for her role as the country music star Juliette Barnes in the series "Nashville."

entries.title: As wildfires get worse, some states are struggling to pass fire protection rules
entries.snippet: There's a lot homeowners can do to prepare for wildfires, such as managing flammable plants and using fire-resistant building materials. But some states struggle to pass rules requiring those steps.

entries.title: Missed shifts were costly to this McDonald's. An app has fixed the problem
entries.snippet: Unexpected absences can cost employers tens of thousands of dollars a month. An app that helps workers with last-minute transportation, food and childcare is making a difference.

entries.title: Cialis is an erectile dysfunction drug. Could it also help you live longer?
entries.snippet: In some wellness circles, tadalafil is promoted as a longevity drug. There is evidence showing a link between it and a lower risk of death in men, but there are no well-controlled trials in humans.

entries.title: Living with nuns: Priced out of D.C., young women found low rent with unlikely roommates
entries.snippet: For 10 years, a Catholic-run home offered young women an affordable place to live in the nation's capital as they studied and launched careers. Now, that community is saying goodbye.

entries.title: Meta heads to court in a landmark trial about kids and social media addiction
entries.snippet: Four states are suing the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, alleging that the platforms were designed to hook kids and that Meta hid the mental health risks.

entries.title: Advocates worry new bans on student IDs will trip up young voters
entries.snippet: New bans on using student IDs for voting in Indiana and New Hampshire have sparked lawsuits after creating the latest hurdles to the ballot box for the U.S. voting-age group least likely to vote.

entries.title: Elon Musk's Starbase wants to expand in south Texas
entries.snippet: Landowners and activists worry about impact to the environment around SpaceX's complex.

entries.title: Morning news brief
entries.snippet: USS Washington to relieve USS Lincoln after concerns about conditions, Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks on Russia, a look at where talks stand regarding the future of Gaza.

entries.title: Firefighters battle massive wildfires in Belgium and Greece as 2 die on an island near Athens
entries.snippet: A blaze in eastern Belgium burned about 12 square miles in the High Fens, a large nature reserve, in one of the country's worst wildfires in recent history.

entries.title: Trump orders Pentagon to scale back joint exercises with South Korea
entries.snippet: Trump said in a social media post that the exercises slated to begin this week are costly and "send a signal that is totally inappropriate and hostile" to North Korea, which he said "has been unthreatening and respectful" while Trump has been in the White House.

entries.title: Lake Powell hits record low, threatening key water and electricity supply for millions
entries.snippet: The alarming milestone at Lake Powell comes about a week after the river's other major reservoir, Lake Mead, also hit a historic low.

entries.title: Fact-checking claims about Taylor Farms' donations to Trump-aligned groups
entries.snippet: Social media users looked into donations the company and its leadership made and drew assumptions about how those influenced the Trump administration's outbreak response.

entries.title: Colombian president asks Trump to suspend tariffs to help earthquake recovery
entries.snippet: De la Espriella took office earlier this month just days before the 7.4 magnitude quake struck.

entries.title: Moroccan security forces arrest nearly 300 migrants trying to reach Spain's Ceuta
entries.snippet: The latest attempt comes two weeks after tens of thousands of would-be migrants, driven by poverty and misinformation, rushed toward Ceuta in one of the deadliest migration crises to hit the region.

entries.title: Chronic pain is missing from America's heat warnings
entries.snippet: The results of a new study suggest that chronic pain deserves a place in how the country prepares people for extreme weather. They also show that rural residents may be the least protected.

entries.title: Kushner has rare meeting with Hamas' leader on Gaza road map. A meeting with Netanyahu is next
entries.snippet: The talks aim to salvage the new 15-point, U.S.-backed road map for Hamas to disarm in Gaza and Israel to withdraw from the Palestinian territory shattered by war.

entries.title: At least 7 people have died from days of heavy rain and record-setting flooding in Indiana
entries.snippet: A 4-year-old boy, two men and three women were among those who had died since the storms began Aug. 11, said Liz Woods, a spokesperson for the state Department of Homeland Security.

entries.title: Republicans won the redistricting competition. Don't tell that to this California congressman
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump last year told GOP-controlled states to redraw their maps before this year's midterm elections to increase the number of winnable seats for Republicans in order to help the party hold onto the U.S. House.

entries.title: Thieves steal 4 Renaissance artworks in a Sicilian museum heist during an Italian holiday
entries.snippet: Art expert Alberto Fiz estimated the value of the stolen works at 70 million euros ($81 million) to 80 million euros ($92 million).

entries.title: Rescuers in Indonesia recover more bodies in earthquake aftermath, raising death toll to 53
entries.snippet: More than 900 homes were destroyed and 450 more damaged in East Nusa Tenggara province, forcing about 5,000 people into temporary shelters.

entries.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks of the war, killing at least 6 people in Russia
entries.snippet: Kyiv has stepped up its attacks on Russia this year, with long-range missiles and swarms of drones targeting military industries and energy facilities.

entries.title: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across the Hawaiian islands
entries.snippet: A search-and-rescue mission was launched after flash floods apparently swept several occupied homes off their foundations in coastal communities, authorities said.

entries.title: Cyclospora spreads through human waste — so how did it get on food?
entries.snippet: The nationwide cyclospora outbreak is very likely a result of sewage contamination in the food supply, according to scientific researchers and public health officials.

entries.title: Indiana authorities say at least 5 people have died as severe weather crosses the state
entries.snippet: The state has been hammered over the past week by heavy rains, resulting in rivers reaching record levels and sending residents in search of higher ground.

entries.title: Democrats' 2028 presidential calendar gives Black and Latino voters and union members an early say
entries.snippet: The primary lineup pushes Iowa from the traditional top spot and makes South Carolina the leadoff state, voting on Jan. 22, 2028, followed by Nevada on Feb. 1.

entries.title: UK's leader calls for reflection after the death of former Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism
entries.snippet: Jason Arday, who became Cambridge's youngest Black professor in 2023, was found dead inside an address in south London on Friday.

entries.title: While Taliban leaders mark 5 years in power in Afghanistan, a UN official warns of a rights crisis
entries.snippet: The Taliban seized power on Aug. 15, 2021, as the U.S. and other NATO troops withdrew following a costly two-decade war. The U.S. withdrawal led to chaos at Kabul airport as crowds of people tried to flee the country in desperation.

entries.title: U.S. pulls last aircraft carrier in Asia as Trump focuses on Iran and the Western Hemisphere
entries.snippet: The USS George Washington is departing the Pacific and expected to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln in the Middle East amid growing concerns about mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed carrier.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Putin visited Kuril to 'punish' Japan over Ukraine stance
entries.snippet: Analysts have said a visit by Russia's leader to a disputed island chain sent a "message" to Japan, which for decades has sought to reclaim control of the territory.

entries.title: Cooler destinations are drawing tourists — can nature cope?
entries.snippet: With heat records continually being broken and southern summers getting hotter, travelers are heading north. Fragile ecosystems are paying the price.

entries.title: Germany's AfD is labeled far-right, populist or extremist
entries.snippet: Right-wing, far-right, fascist: Many terms are being thrown around in the debate about the AfD. What do they mean, and how appropriate are they when discussing the AfD? DW has this glossary.

entries.title: DRC Ebola outbreak becomes deadliest in country's history
entries.snippet: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has now killed 2,325 people, according to government figures. The UN says one person in the country is dying every 30 minutes of the disease.

entries.title: Indonesia: Thousands await aid as quake death toll rises to 68
entries.snippet: Indonesia marked its Independence Day on Monday but celebrations have been overshadowed by an earthquake which has left over 60 people dead and thousands homeless. Residents say they need aid as soon as possible.

entries.title: India's testing agency in focus after more exams canceled
entries.snippet: Months after canceling the medical entrance exam, India's testing agency has canceled three other exams prompting outrage among opposition leaders. In Bihar, several people were killed in a temple stampede. DW has more

entries.title: Fatty food raises risk of colorectal cancer
entries.snippet: Did you know fatty foods can increase production of an acid in your gut that promotes tumor growth? That's on top of all the other health risks linked to fatty foods, like fries and burgers.

entries.title: Germany news: Belgium blaze kept out of Germany for now
entries.snippet: Some residents in the Eifel town of Monschau were evacuated as a massive fire in Belgium threatened to cross the border. Meanwhile, shipping shortfalls amid low river water levels could hit the construction industry.

entries.title: US actress Hayden Panettiere dies at 36
entries.snippet: Hayden Panettiere's death was announced by her father in a statement to US network ABC news. The actress was known for her roles in TV shows such as "Nashville" and "Heroes."

entries.title: Hundreds flee as Belgium battles wildfire at German border
entries.snippet: A rapidly spreading wildfire has scorched about 2,700 hectares in the High Fens nature reserve near Belgium's border with Germany. Some homes in the German town of Monschau were evacuated overnight as a precaution.

entries.title: India temple stampede in Bihar kills 7
entries.snippet: At least seven people were killed after a stampede broke out at a Hindu shrine in eastern India. An investigation into the incident is underway.

entries.title: Trump says US-South Korea military drills to be scaled back
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump believes annual military drills with South Korea send an "inappropriate and hostile" signal to North Korea. Seoul says it is reviewing Trump's remarks.

entries.title: Italy: Thieves steal key Renaissance paintings in Sicily
entries.snippet: Four Renaissance paintings by Antonello da Messina were stolen from his Sicilian hometown on Saturday after surviving earthquakes and centuries of history. Crooks took them while locals celebrated a religious holiday.

entries.title: UAE, Saudi Arabia, others condemn Israel's rejection of Trump Gaza plan
entries.snippet: The statement came as US envoy Jared Kushner and Gaza peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov held ceasefire and implementation talks with regional mediators and Hamas in Egypt.

entries.title: Why Kyiv keeps attacking Russian retail giant Wildberries
entries.snippet: Ukraine has been striking warehouses belonging to Russia's largest online marketplace, saying the attacks disrupt Moscow's military logistics. But experts see wider risks for Russia's economy.

entries.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest attacks of war
entries.snippet: Russia says hundreds of drones targeted Moscow overnight, with six fatalities in the capital and southern Rostov region. Five people were killed in strikes across Ukraine.

entries.title: Bus crash in Hungary kills at least 12
entries.snippet: Police say they have arrested the driver of a bus that crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people. The bus was carrying Polish pilgrims, media report.

entries.title: Troops from North Korea to boost Russia's Ukraine forces
entries.snippet: Intelligence agencies report that North Korea is preparing to send up to 50,000 troops to Russia. But military experts doubt this will make a fundamental difference in the course of Russia's war with Ukraine.

entries.title: US: Hurricane Lala brings Hawaii heavy rain, strong winds
entries.snippet: The Category 1 storm passed over Hawaii's Big Island without making landfall and is gradually weakening. However, the hurricane caused roads to flood and turned rivers into raging torrents.
